scope: All currently listed Bronze, Silver, and Gold objects for the two configured datasets; one current object per layer per dataset at audit time.

bronze_to_silver_to_gold_lineage.limitations: Duplicate identical signatures can only be verified as multiset counts; no cross-layer row-number assumption.

issues.root_cause: Shared session IDs are already associated with multiple users in Bronze; Silver/Gold pass through the source session ID without namespacing by user.
issues.confidence: HIGH
issues.proposed_fix: Use a composite analytical session key (user_id, source_session_id) for session modeling while retaining the original source session_id unchanged for lineage.

issues.root_cause: Equal timestamps occur in Bronze. The source contains no explicit per-event order field; pipeline timestamp normalization does not create one.
issues.confidence: HIGH for collisions; UNVERIFIED for intended order within tied events.
issues.proposed_fix: Keep ties explicit; add a source-derived stable ordering field only if its semantics are documented. Do not treat file or Parquet row order as behavioral order.

issues.root_cause: Repeated content is present in Bronze. Gold IDs are intentionally generated per Silver row, so identical interactions retain different IDs; no excess row-count growth is observed across the layers.
issues.confidence: HIGH that repeated records exist and persist; UNVERIFIED whether repeats are accidental or valid repeated behavior.
issues.proposed_fix: Do not deduplicate automatically. Add a reviewable duplicate policy and preserve raw events; report exact-source duplicates separately from repeated interaction signatures.

issues.root_cause: Neither Bronze schema provides an explicit event position. MerRec has sequence_id and sequence_length, but not a per-event position. Gold adapter leaves position_in_session null.
issues.confidence: HIGH for missing explicit position; UNVERIFIED that a position can be reconstructed from timestamp ties or source row order.
issues.proposed_fix: Keep position null until a semantically valid source order is available; expose sequence_id/sequence_length as metadata, not as an invented position.

issues.root_cause: Missing session values are present at Bronze and preserved by the mappings; Gold copies the nullable session field.
issues.confidence: HIGH
issues.proposed_fix: Preserve null sessions and exclude them from session-based grouping; do not infer session IDs without a documented sessionization rule.

issues.root_cause: REES46 adapter filters remove_from_cart if present; it is absent in this snapshot.
issues.confidence: HIGH
issues.proposed_fix: Keep source actions in Bronze and record excluded counts in run metadata. Add a new normalized event only after defining its semantics and evaluating the event contract.

issues.root_cause: Purchase frequency is the observed distribution of this snapshot after the configured event mapping; no Gold filtering of supported purchase events is observed.
issues.confidence: HIGH for counts; conversion interpretation is not supported by this event-log denominator.
issues.proposed_fix: Report event prevalence; use a conversion metric only with defined eligible users/sessions, exposure, and attribution windows.

affected.bronze_profile_scope: All source events; item counts are from mapped interactions.

issues.root_cause: Long-tail product frequency and sparse user-item interactions are present in the observed snapshot; for MerRec the configured scope is one sample shard.
issues.confidence: HIGH for this snapshot; not generalizable to the full MerRec dataset.
issues.proposed_fix: State snapshot scope in benchmarks; defer K-core filtering and train/test design to an explicit experiment protocol.

bronze_to_silver_mapping_check.method: Multiset comparison by exact event signature plus canonical (brand, category_id, category_code, price); no row-number join.

issues.root_cause: For available fields, missing values originate in Bronze and are preserved by the Silver mapping. Gold intentionally has no brand/category fields in its 11-column event contract.
issues.confidence: HIGH for observed coverage and mapping equality; Gold omission is confirmed by its schema.
issues.proposed_fix: Use Silver/source_attributes for semantic features or add a separately versioned product dimension; do not synthesize missing catalog values.
